verdict.rationale: Issuing supports background automation at the API level. A synchronous webhook can approve or decline authorizations in real time, spending controls are enforced automatically, single-use virtual cards invalidate themselves after use, and 'Issuing for agents' lets agents make purchases autonomously. However, this all depends on the user building their own webhook and integration logic; there is no evidence of a built-in automation builder or scheduled background jobs. Missing for 10: native user-configurable automation/workflow setup, scheduling or trigger configuration without custom code, independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.
